source_quote: All College of Business Administration students must take 41 credit hours of mandatory
answer: All business students take 41 credits of mandatory college courses: BACC 205, BACC 255, BADM 215, BADM 235, BADM 230, BADM 250, BADM 290, BADM 420, BECN 301, BECN 302, BFIN 300, BITM 300, BITM 350, BMGT 200, BMKA 200, and MATH 207 College Algebra.
Marketing and Advertising students take GRDS 220 Introduction to Digital Media instead of BADM 420 Quantitative Methods for Business.

source_quote: Students who pass the test take a free elective instead of MATH 207.
answer: Business students who do not pass the Mathematics Placement Test must take MATH 207 College Algebra; those who pass take a free elective instead.
The prerequisite for BFIN 300 Financial Management I is BACC 205.

answer: BADM 230 Business Law, 3(3,0): the legal framework of business under Lebanese law - legal concepts, sources of law, contracts, legal forms of business organizations, the commercial code and labor issues.

answer: BADM 235 Business Research Methodology, 1(1,0): problem definition, research design, data collection and sampling, ending with a research proposal.

answer: BFIN 300 Financial Management I, 3(3,0): corporate finance principles - simple and compound interest, risk and return, time value of money, stock and bond valuation, discounted cash flow and financial ratios.

source_quote: Requirements for the Bachelor of Business Administration degree are program-specific.
answer: BBA program requirements are program-specific, split into major and non-major categories with mandatory and elective courses; details are in each student's Student Study Plan (SSP).

source_quote: The letter “B” refers to the College of
answer: CBA course codes are 'BABC xyz': B = College of Business Administration; ABC = program (ACC Accounting, ADM General Business Administration, ECN Economics, FIN Finance, HRM HR Management, ITM IT Management, MGT Management, MKA Marketing and Advertising); xyz between 200 and 599, first digit = level (e.g., BMKA 200 is a sophomore marketing course).

source_quote: The Center is in room H 101 and is open to all students throughout the week. The LSC
answer: The CBA Learning Support Center, in room H 101 and open all week, offers peer tutoring by Teaching Assistants (graduate and upper-level students) with an on-call faculty member, plus books, study guides, course materials, computers and videos.
